description: This file defines a Java interface 'WithNamespace' that provides a method to access a namespace string, serving as a contract for classes related to namespace handling within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: WithNamespace
classes.description: A common interface for all types that provide access to a namespace, requiring implementation of the getNamespace() method.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace associated with the command.
